text: As he recalled his past. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan Ilyich noticed a strange pattern. <break time="0.8s" /> For the further back he went. <break time="0.8s" /> Into his childhood. <break time="0.8s" /> The more real joy he found. <break time="0.8s" /> While the later years of success. <break time="0.8s" /> Seemed ever emptier. <break time="0.8s" /> Then came a question. <break time="0.8s" /> He had always driven away. <break time="0.8s" /> A question so terrible. <break time="0.8s" /> That he could hardly bear to face it. <break time="0.8s" /> Namely whether his whole life. <break time="0.8s" /> Had been, in fact, entirely wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> He had defended his correct and respectable life. <break time="0.8s" /> Against this doubt. <break time="0.8s" /> But now. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at the faces of his wife and the doctor. <break time="0.8s" /> He saw in them. <break time="0.8s" /> Everything he had lived by and it was all a deception. <break time="0.8s" /> For three days he struggled. <break time="0.8s" /> As if someone were pushing him. <break time="0.8s" /> Into a narrow black sack. <break time="0.8s" /> And what held him back. <break time="0.8s" /> Was not the darkness itself. <break time="0.8s" /> But his belief. <break time="0.8s" /> That his life had been a good one. <break time="0.8s" /> At the very end of the third day. <break time="0.8s" /> His young son crept quietly. <break time="0.8s" /> To the bedside. <break time="0.8s" /> And Ivan Ilyich. <break time="0.8s" /> Feeling the boys tears and kiss upon his hand. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly felt sorry for him. <break time="0.8s" /> At that same moment. <break time="0.8s" /> He broke through into a light. <break time="0.8s" /> And he understood. <break time="0.8s" /> That although his life had not been what it should have been it was still possible to set it right. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at his weeping wife and son with pity. <break time="0.8s" /> He wished to free them. <break time="0.8s" /> From his suffering. <break time="0.8s" /> And he tried to say Forgive. <break time="0.8s" /> But the word came out wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> And he simply let it go. <break time="0.8s" /> Searching for his old fear of death. <break time="0.8s" /> He could no longer find it. <break time="0.8s" /> For where death had been there was only light. <break time="0.8s" /> And he said to himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Death is finished, it is no more.
